# Oscar Mañas

> Oscar Mañas (also written Oscar Manas), Research Scientist at Meta Superintelligence Labs, Zurich.
> Images, video, language, and even actions are different aspects of the same underlying reality. I build multimodal models that understand and generate images, video, and text, along with the metrics and reward models that evaluate and steer them. Lately, I've been drawn to embodied and physical AI. I believe that vision-language-action models (VLAs) and world-action models (WAMs) are the natural next step for VLMs and video world models: actions are just another modality represented as a sequence of embeddings. What a model learns from observation can then carry over to action, and from there, to improving itself through its own experience.

## Current Role

Research Scientist, Meta Superintelligence Labs, Zurich (Oct 2025 – present)
Working on generative model distillation and real-time interactive world models, delivering 10× speedups for image-editing models deployed across Meta's products.

## Previous Roles

- Visiting Researcher, Meta FAIR, Montreal (2024 – 2025). Reward-guided decoding to control multimodal LLMs at inference time, cutting object hallucination by ~70% (ICCV 2025).
- Research Scientist Intern, Meta FAIR, Montreal (2023). Automatic prompt optimization (OPT2I) improving text-to-image consistency by up to 25% (TMLR 2024, Featured Certification).
- Research Intern, Element AI, Montreal (2020 – 2021). Seasonal Contrast (SeCo), self-supervised pre-training for remote sensing (ICCV 2021; 500+ citations).
- Computer Vision Engineer, Mediapro R&D, Barcelona (2019 – 2020). Real-time video analysis pipelines for automatic sports production, deployed in live broadcast.
- Research Assistant, Image Processing Group, UPC, Barcelona (2018 – 2019). Self-supervised visual representations for sample-efficient reinforcement learning.
- Deep Learning Engineer, Restb.ai, Barcelona (2017 – 2019). Production visual-recognition models for real-estate imagery at scale.
- Research Assistant, Architectures and Compilers Group, UPC, Barcelona (2016 – 2017). Efficient deep neural network inference on low-power edge devices.

## Education

- PhD Computer Science, Mila / Université de Montréal (2021–2025). Advisor: Prof. Aishwarya Agrawal. GPA 4.3/4.3. Thesis: [Towards efficient, reliable and measurable vision-language systems](https://hdl.handle.net/1866/44263)
- MSc Computer Vision, Universitat Autònoma de Barcelona / Computer Vision Center (2018–2020). Rank 1/35.
- BSc Computer Science, Universitat Politècnica de Catalunya (2013–2017). Rank 1/235.

## Research Expertise

- Multimodal learning and vision-language models
- Embodied and physical AI: vision-language-action models (VLAs) and world-action models (WAMs)
- World models
- Reward models and reward-guided decoding
- Evaluation & benchmarks for vision-language systems
- Image and video generation
- Visual grounding and vision-language understanding

Keywords: multimodal AI, vision-language models, VLA, world-action models, world models, embodied AI, physical AI, robotics, reward models, image and video generation
